title: Cycle count Cancel still shows the discard dialog for tracked counts, and an untracked row never triggers it
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T1 (tracked, with stock) and QAPL-U2 (untracked, 2 bins). Note QAPL-T1's quantity.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory search QAPL-T1, then ⋮ (button_inventory_actions) → Cycle count (menu_item_inventory_cycle_count).
  2. Type a count different from the noted quantity on QAPL-T1's row.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Confirm discarding the counts.
  5. Search QAPL-U2, then ⋮ → Cycle count.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
1. Count mode starts; QAPL-T1's row has count inputs and "Count changes available" shows.
  2. The count is accepted and "Count changes available" moves.
  3. The discard dialog shows (unsaved counts) and the mode stays on until it is answered.
  4. Count mode ends with no save; QAPL-T1 still shows the noted quantity.
  5. QAPL-U2's cell reads "Not Tracked" (text_count_not_tracked_{id}) with no inputs; nothing can be typed and "Count changes available" does not move.
  6. Count mode ends at once with no discard dialog.
